name: When should I call a professional fire damage restoration company?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional fire damage restoration company?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should contact a professional fire damage restoration company as soon as possible after the fire has been extinguished and the property is deemed safe to enter by authorities. Swift action is crucial to prevent secondary damage, such as corrosion from acidic soot or mold growth from water used in firefighting. Professionals have the specialized equipment and expertise to safely assess the damage, mitigate further issues, and begin the cleanup and restoration process effectively. Early intervention can significantly reduce overall repair costs and restoration time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional immediately after the fire is out and the property is safe. Prompt action prevents secondary damage like corrosion or mold.
